focus: Egyptian tax-benefit surface: progressive PIT with phase-out, social insurance contributions under the unified Law 148/2019 regime, VAT and schedule tax, and the Takaful & Karama cash transfers.
purpose: Household-level comparison-oracle and supporting-source references for Egypt Axiom coverage. None of these are legal authority.
oracle_scope: A RuleSpec oracle must be an executable, pinned external calculator that accepts household-level inputs and returns household-level tax-benefit outputs comparable to Axiom outputs. Aggregate simulators, distributional reports, parameter documentation, and public model summaries are supporting references only, not oracles.

oracles.name: EGYMOD
oracles.dataset: HIECS-based input microdata (shipped with the licensed bundle where included)
oracles.role: Household-level tax-benefit comparison oracle for Egypt. Policy years 2019-25. Report CR-EGYMOD-v1.0 (UNU-WIDER).

availability_check.detail: The locally held licensed SOUTHMOD bundle (EUROMOD runtime proven on the Ghana and Rwanda lanes) must be inventoried for EGYMOD EG systems before wiring. Validation frame: EGYMOD v1.0, policy years 2019-25.
